note: Wikidata q-ids only. The owner tested pins here by eye before any of this existed: the two Carmo churches came out on top of each other and the old market landed two streets off. Both are handled below. NOTE for whoever adds places: an English search on Wikidata returns nothing for 'Igreja do Carmo Porto' and a Portuguese one returns eight churches in eight towns. Always confirm the description says Porto. No entrance is claimed anywhere: no door here has been measured, so every point is the centroid or area it actually is. Ten of these thirteen places are carried over from the Explorer product on origin/main, whose text is the raw material for the city file; the three museums with interiors are new, because Explorer has no museum model.
